scope: 45 independently preregistered interactions over ten public UAE originals from ten different recordings. Each of five positive scenes shows one or more marked empty bays. Each scene has a travel-lane control. Four additional genuine previously accepted lane taps were rerun with the exact original photo and rectangle, using neutral typed text. A separate equivocal prior entrance is reported independently. One AI reviewer supplied photographic references. No driver, passenger or legal adjudication is part of this test.
independence: The six primary recordings were outside earlier frontage, manual-mark, owner and fine-tap test batches. Four supplemental recordings appeared in earlier point/frontage work. All ten images already belonged to the project's public catalogue. The ten complete image/word/polygon/tap references were sealed before the first comparison. Geometry developers received the aggregate first-freeze failure, never individual held-out scenes or marks before this release assessment. Later revisions are repeated measurements on this fixed set. Source 66245/146 and its entire recording, later supplied directly by the user, do not occur among these ten drives.
measurement: Original photo bytes and native dimensions were validated through the ordinary local web service. Automatic requests used the same nonblocking submission and interactive deadline as the public page. Marking used a fresh, explicitly passenger-selected session for each tap. Stable local automatic evidence and signed surface maps could be cached. Timings are elapsed web response times from submit, excluding image loading, passenger interaction and first-time preparation. In baseline W01 and possibly W02 an initial synchronous diagnostic could have warmed underlying model caches. Only the ordinary interactive run is graded.
grade_definition: A correct automatic or guided whole bay requires an actual confirmable point in the desired original-pixel reference plus a visible outlined region with IoU at least 0.45, predicted-area precision at least 0.70 and reference coverage at least 0.50. Matching the point alone and asking for a generic retap on a shared line are reported separately. Provider error and timeout receive no abstention credit.

first_geometry_freeze_diagnostic.diagnosis: On four of the five visually positive scenes, the primary reference covered 47–98% segmentation-class parking, and the image divider detector found 5–9 lines, but none of its geometric pairs survived. On the fifth, all five visual bay polygons had 0% segmentation-class parking. The 81-image catalogue histogram describes frequency of a proposed region; it has no denominator of independently confirmed valid bays and is not an accuracy score.

replay.roles: All direct taps belonged to the passenger and were excluded from model-found totals. Automatic submissions were separate, used predicted tracks, and could never silently substitute a manual tap. The local release image libraries reproduced each available trained model render and signed contour packet for the applicable methods. Timed-out cases replay as an operational error.
replay.time_scope: Each direct mark and automatic request was bound to a single original photo and source dimensions. Feature inference selected tracks at that frame. Future observations are rejected when validating the input.

fused_8805_first_turn_diagnosis.scope: Replayed the first-turn routing and signed region candidates for each input on the 8805 version, distinguishing failure to form any matching region from failure to select one. Only the positive cases are listed.

prospective.scope: Five additional existing public UAE photographs, each from a different drive that did not appear among the first ten or the new user-supplied curbside drive. The model bank already had automatically prepared signed evidence for every photo. For this cohort the independent judge selected the photos and traced visible areas on the originals without consulting their model predictions or whole-bay annotations. These are newly labelled task cases inside a known photo bank, not five never-processed images.

repeated_desktop_P01.note: The first normal HTTP submission used the empty-surface route and withheld. A later identical browser submission used the model frontage route and returned a point in reference bay A. That repeat displayed no whole-bay outline. It is recorded separately from the first submission.

post_correction_15_drive_summary.interpretation: Ten fixed-regression and five previously prospective drives were both rerun after the occupied-frontage example had been disclosed. Each contributes one natural typed sentence. Multiple passenger-selected taps can come from one photo.
post_correction_15_drive_summary.scope: A visible point or a surface patch can match the intended location while its true bay bounds remain unresolved. Access, legality, vehicle clearance and real passenger acceptance were not evaluated.

additional_canonical_rerun.reason: After an additional parser update, the currently running application was retested separately from the frozen staged comparison.

visible_road_connectivity_delta.scope: Post-exposure delta on the same 15 recordings. Forty-seven original photo hashes and tapped rectangles were matched exactly, with separate ordinary public sessions on each revision. Three earlier typed phrases were also repeated through the updated local page API. This is a targeted change check.
